video.title: Palekh Watch – with a real painting on the dial

picture.title: Hand Painting
picture.intro: Each dial is hand-painted and keeps in itself the beauty of the unique Palekh miniature, known throughout the world.
article: Each dial is hand-painted and keeps in itself the beauty of the unique Palekh miniature, known throughout the world. Rich colours, delicate lines, filigree brushstrokes and emotional plots of folk tales caused a sensation at the Venetian Art Vernissage and the World Expo in Paris. Now your wrist will also be decorated with legendary paintings.

The secrets of painting technology are passed down from generation to generation. The watch has preserved the centuries-old traditions of Russian artists. First, the masters cover the dials with black enamel, transfer the sketch with pumice stone, then apply whitewash. Next, they paint the dials with tempera paints.

Your favourite characters from folk tales come to life under thin brushes. Here the firebird takes off, here the three horses are running, cutting through the air, and here is a beautiful maiden with a basket in a strawberry meadow. Then the artists varnish the painting, apply gold, polish it with a wolf's fang, reapply the varnish and add gloss.

gears.title: Swiss Movement
article: The watches are skillfully crafted both inside and outside. Reliable Swiss or Japanese movements are responsible for the accuracy. The anti-shock device protects against shock vibrations. The watches are assembled by Poljot Klassika company with a 25-year history and a reputation of a reliable manufacturer.

box.title: Wood Watch Box
article: The watch is packed in a premium gift case of noble walnut colour. The case is made of precious wood and coated with a varnish. Inside it is finished with beige flock.

belt.title: Leather Strap
article: Another striking element of the composition is a strap made of textured embossed genuine leather. Available in 7 different shades that harmoniously complement the miniature: black, brown, white, red, navy blue, green or beige.

case.title: Case and Glass
article: The quality and reliability of the watch is also emphasized by the case. It is made of zinc-aluminium alloy or stainless steel with a gold or chrome plating. The metallic luster beautifully accentuates the dials. Waterproof mineral glass protects against household scratches. Watch is resistant to minor accidental splashes.

about.title: About Palekh Watch project
article: Time for art! Unique Palekh Watch combine the beauty of Palekh painting with the quality of Japanese and Swiss watch movements.

This watch is not just a beautiful accessory, but a real piece of art that retains warmth of handmade work and centuries-old traditions of craftsmanship. Each dial is hand-painted by an artisan from the village of Palekh, following all stages of traditional miniature creation. For example, the accents are painted with gold - just like a hundred years ago. The creation of a single dial can take the whole month because of such delicate work. Favorite fairy tales, traditional ornaments and the unique beauty of nature became the inspiration for miniatures. In addition, we produce seasonal limited edition watches.
Palekh Watch is presented exclusively on the Global Rus Trade marketplace.

alts: Paintings on the dials are made by artisans from Palekh.
The accents on the paintings are made with gold.
Artisans transfer paintings to the dials from original sketches.

questions.question: What is the cost and terms of delivery?
answer: Delivery within Russia is free and is carried out by Russian Post within 2-14 days. For Moscow and the Moscow region - the next day.
Delivery to other countries as well as by courier services is paid for. Its cost can be calculated automatically when placing an order on the website.
To place an order through a manager, please contact us at {primary_phone}, {secondary_phone} or e-mail {email}.

questions.question: I want to give a watch as a gift. How to do it?
answer: Any watch can be sent in a gift box, enclosing a postcard with your wishes.
To place an order as a gift, please contact us by phones {primary_phone}, {secondary_phone} or e-mail {email}.

questions.question: Can I try on a watch before I buy it?
answer: You can try on a watch in the office of Global Rus Trade at Bersenevskaya embankment, 6, building 1, Moscow, Russia. Please notify us of your visit and book the model you like. Since watches are very popular, some models may not be available.

If it is not possible to come, you can use the online fitting by receiving a video of the watch on a man's or woman's hand. To do this, contact us by phone {primary_phone}, {secondary_phone} or by e-mail {email}.
Also, some models of our watches are available in other Russian cities
St. Petersburg Bolshoy Prospekt P. S., 58, Gallery "A Priori"
Novokuznetsk  Suvorov str., 8, Gallery of jewelry art "Almazy Yakutii"

questions.question: What does the warranty cover?
answer: A warranty of at least 1 year applies to the movement, hands and case. During the warranty period, adjustments, repairs, replacement of assembly units or movement is free of charge, if the malfunction or failure of the watch is not caused by accident or improper operation.
To take advantage of the warranty case, contact us by e-mail {alt_email} or call {alt_phone}

The warranty does not cover aesthetic changes, defects and damage resulting from normal wear, tear and aging (for example, minor scratches on the case or glass, wear on the bracelet, peeling of the coating, etc.).

questions.question: Is it possible to exchange or return an item?
answer: We will return the item free of charge within 30 days of receipt. The watch must be unused, in its original packaging with intact labels and protective films, without scratches, wrinkles on the straps and other signs of wear.
To issue a refund, please contact us by phone {primary_phone}, {secondary_phone} or by e-mail {email}.
